svg.title: 刀与盾 · 白底 · 精细曲线抠边
svg.desc: Refined white-background antique emblem. The cutout is defined by smooth cubic Bezier contours instead of pixel stair-step clipping. Acute tips, ring holes and long tassel channels are retained; tiny enclosed matte pinholes are repaired and cord attachments refined. Artwork remains vector geometry with no raster images or external resources.
